'''''Applied Numerical Mathematics''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published monthly by [[Elsevier]] on behalf of [[International Association for Mathematics and Computers in Simulation]]. Established in 2001, it covers [[numerical analysis]] and [[computational mathematics]] as well as its applications in physics and [[engineering]].<ref name="overview">{{cite web |title=Aims and scope: Applied Numerical Mathematics|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/applied-numerical-mathematics/about/aims-and-scope |website=sciencedirect.com |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |access-date=August 25, 2026}}</ref> Its current [[editor-in-chief|editors-in-chief]] are Zdzislaw Jackiewicz ([[Arizona State University]]) and Thiab Taha ([[University of Georgia]]).<ref name="editorial">{{cite web |title=Editorial board: Applied Numerical Mathematics|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/applied-numerical-mathematics/about/editorial-board |website=sciencedirect.com |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |access-date=August 25, 2026}}</ref>
